meaning: The hardcoded patient list 081 083 137 150 fixes which four recordings are refit and streamed, with 16 windows and 45 iterations each by default. Any aggregate built from modelplots/ude_cv_m6/api is therefore a comparison over exactly this cohort and this fit budget.

could_move.what: The m6 cross-validation cohort is fixed to four IDs; adding or dropping a patient changes which cases any aggregate metric averages over.
NWIN and ITERS defaults (16 windows, 45 iterations) set the per-window fit budget, so fit quality and the resulting comparison can shift if the script is called with other arguments.
Outputs land in one shared directory keyed only by patient, so a rerun with different settings overwrites logs a comparison may have been read from.
The deck reaching this model compares m5 against m6; if the two sides are not run on the same patient list, that comparison is not like-for-like.

expectation: Unknown. I cannot tell from this context how sensitive the m5-vs-m6 comparison is to cohort membership or to the iteration budget.

check.why: Runs one patient for one short window to confirm the per-patient entry point and see what it writes, without the ~65 min full stream.
